context: Tests whether the agent maps the Ruby manifest to the ruby language parameter, prefers Gemfile.lock pinned versions over Gemfile ranges, and correctly formats the CLI command and report.

checklist.name: ruby language
checklist.description: Sets language to `ruby` for gem packages (not `gem`, `rubygems`, or `rails`)

checklist.name: Gemfile.lock preferred
checklist.description: Extracts dependency versions from `Gemfile.lock` rather than the version ranges in `Gemfile`

checklist.name: Pinned versions used
checklist.description: The versions sent to the CLI match the pinned versions in Gemfile.lock (e.g. rails 5.2.3, nokogiri 1.9.1) rather than Gemfile ranges

checklist.name: JSON array format
checklist.description: Constructs a JSON array of `{language, name, version}` objects and pipes it to `npx @meterian/cli check`

checklist.name: Markdown table
checklist.description: Report contains a markdown table with audit result columns (Package, Version, Severity, ID, Safe Versions)

checklist.name: Summary line
checklist.description: Report includes a summary line with vulnerability and package counts
